# Checklist

A list of checks with passed, failed, warning and pending rows, each with a glyph, a short label and an optional note on what to do, plus a counts summary.

`SongNodes.Checklist` · Data

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.Checklist items={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.Checklist" items="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (ChecklistProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` * | `{ state: "pass" \| "fail" \| "warn" \| "pending"; label: string; note?: string; aside?: string }[]` | Check rows in display order. |
| `summary` | `boolean` | Show the counts summary above the list. |
| `compact` | `boolean` | Tight rows without dividers (table cells, tooltips). |
